description: Cross-implementation vector for the /login-app request, contract version 2 (the request that names its network). Every value is fixed and NOT secret; never use them for anything else. The app builds exactly `fragment` from `request` (the six keys in the order of `keys`, after the page address and the '#'); the page, with its clock at request.ts, parses `fragment` into exactly `request`. pk is the public key of the app secret key in tests/fixtures/app-auth-vector.json (bytes 1..32), the same key as its appPk.
